versos.texto_bv: Quando alguém se aproximava para se curvar diante dele, Absalão estendia a mão, segurava a pessoa e a beijava.
versos.traducao_literal: E acontecia, ao aproximar-se um homem para curvar-se a ele, que estendia sua mão, segurava-o e beijava-o.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Omissão do verbo “abraçar” (hebraico חָזַק, ‘segurar/abraçar’). — evidência: O texto-fonte apresenta três ações: estender a mão, abraçar/segurar, beijar. NTLH (“segurava, abraçava e beijava”), ARA (“estendia a mão e, pegando nele o beijava”) e NVIPT (“estendia a mão, abraçava-o e beijava-o”) incluem as três. A BV condensou em duas ações, omitindo o abraço. Correção exige adição de conteúdo.

kjv.texto: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

vizinhos.4: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!
vizinhos.6: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

web.texto: It was so, that when any man came near to do him obeisance, he stretched out his hand, and took hold of him, and kissed him.

vizinhos.4: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”
vizinhos.6: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

versos.texto_bv: Ao fim de quarenta anos, Absalão disse ao rei: “Permita-me ir a Hebrom para cumprir o voto que fiz ao SENHOR.
versos.traducao_literal: E aconteceu ao fim de quarenta anos: e disse Absalão ao rei: “Irei, por favor, e cumprirei meu voto que votei ao SENHOR em Hebrom.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Variante textual: “quarenta anos” (TM) vs. “quatro anos” (LXX, siríaco, algumas edições). — evidência: NTLH (“Quatro anos depois”), ARA (“ao cabo de quatro anos”) e NVIPT (“Ao final de quatro anos”) convergem em “quatro”. A BV segue o Texto Massorético (“quarenta anos”). A escolha entre variantes é decisão de crítica textual, não de forma; correção exigiria alteração semântica.

kjv.texto: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the Lord, in Hebron.

vizinhos.6: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
vizinhos.8: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the Lord shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the Lord.

web.texto: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron.

vizinhos.6: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
vizinhos.8: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If Yahweh shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve Yahweh.’”
